getting_started.title: Get Started
getting_started.description: Join our global community of changemakers creating happier cities through local action. Whether you're new or experienced, there's a path for everyone.

guides.title: Host Your First Gathering
guides.description: Learn how to organize a public happiness event in your community.

guides.title: Join the Movement
guides.description: Connect with like-minded people and find gatherings near you.

guides.title: Build Projects
guides.description: Contribute to global initiatives making the world a happier place.

gatherings.title: Gatherings (Local)
gatherings.description: Meet positive people nearby and join Public Happiness Gatherings - from music jams and free hugs to community connection events.

projects.title: Projects (Global)
projects.description: Collaborate on global initiatives that create positive change. Build tools, resources, and campaigns that spread happiness worldwide.

items.title: World Freehugs Day
items.description: Join thousands worldwide in spreading warmth and connection through the simple act of offering free hugs.

items.title: International Pillow Fight Day
items.description: A playful celebration bringing communities together through the joy of friendly pillow battles.

projects.title: Public Happiness Token
projects.description: A cryptocurrency designed to reward positive community actions and fund local happiness initiatives.

projects.title: Happiness Map
projects.description: An interactive map connecting people with local gatherings, activities, and positive community members.

projects.title: Community Platform
projects.description: Building the digital infrastructure to support and grow the Public Happiness Movement globally.
